data.title: Bitcoin Suisse relocating half of Swiss jobs to cheaper overseas hubs for operational efficiency amid global expansion.
data.description: A Swiss company specializing in cryptocurrency financial services is looking to transfer some of its back-office operations to more cost-effective international locations. This strategic move is part of its efforts to grow its worldwide wealth and asset management business.

data.title: Knowesis Achieves CMMC Level 2 Certification, Reinforcing Its Commitment to Defense Cybersecurity
data.description: In Fairfax, Virginia, on September 11, 2026, Knowesis declared that it has accomplished its assessment for Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Level 2. This certification verifies that Knowesis has met the Level 2 criteria for CMMC assessment scope.

data.title: Jaguar LAA, Inc. Announces Acquisition of Assets Related to the Laminar Program
data.description: Jaguar LAA, Inc. has recently completed a transaction aimed at propelling the advancement of the Laminar program, which focuses on left atrial appendage closure for individuals suffering from non-valvular atrial fibrillation. This Santa Rosa-based company finalized the transaction on September 11, 2026. The company's innovative approach has attracted attention, highlighting its potential to significantly impact patients with this condition. Jaguar's forward trajectory in this area aligns with its commitment to providing effective solutions for those affected by non-valvular atrial fibrillation.

data.title: LifeCare Home Health & Hospice Family Agencies Earn 2025 SHPBest Awards for Patient and Caregiver Experience
data.description: Eternal Faith Hospice and Beyond Faith Homecare, based in Irving, Texas, were recently commended for their exemplary service in hospice caregiving and home health patient satisfaction. The recognition came from LifeCare Home Health & Hospice Family, revealing that four facilities under their umbrella were ranked among the top-performing providers in these aspects. The acknowledgment was received on September 11, 2026, highlighting the dedication of the teams at Eternal Faith Hospice and Beyond Faith Homecare to ensuring exceptional care experiences.

data.title: Ball Announces Investment in New Manufacturing Facility in Uttar Pradesh, India
data.description: On September 11, 2026, Ball Corporation, a renowned provider of sustainable aluminum packaging, revealed their intentions to extend their presence in India by establishing a new beverage can production plant in Uttar Pradesh. The facility is part of the company's efforts to enhance its manufacturing capabilities and meet the escalating demand for beverage cans in the region. This expansion highlights Ball Corporation's commitment to sustainability and reinforces its position as a key player in the industry.

data.title: Evergreen Digital Media Corp. Partners With Adwave Digital Inc. in a Strategic Capital and Licensing Partnership
data.description: A significant agreement has been reached between Evergreen Digital Media Corp. (EDM) and Adwave Digital Inc., prominent entities in the digital media and technology sectors respectively. The two companies have formalized a strategic partnership in Denver on September 11, 2026. EDM specializes in managing digital signage and retail media networks, while Adwave is known for its AI-driven advertising platform. The collaboration involves leveraging each other's expertise to enhance their offerings. This development holds promise for both entities, potentially leading to improved reach and efficiency in their operations.

data.title: Armor Health Remembers September 11 and Reaffirms Commitment to Public Safety
data.description: On September 11, 2026, in Miami, Armor Health (Armorhealthcare.com) commemorates the 25th anniversary of the September 11, 2001 attacks. The company joins the nation in honoring the lives lost and the heroic actions of individuals who responded, displaying exceptional bravery.

data.title: Village Super Market, Inc. Declares Quarterly Dividend
data.description: On September 11, 2026, the Board of Directors of Village Super Market, Inc. announced quarterly cash dividends for shareholders. They declared $0.25 per Class A common share and $0.1625 per Class B common share. These dividends are set to be paid on October 22, 2026, to shareholders holding positions as of the market close on October 1, 2026.

data.title: Gran Tierra Energy Inc. Announces Consent Solicitation for Senior Secured Amortizing Notes due 2031
data.description: On September 11, 2026, Gran Tierra Energy Inc. has initiated a solicitation to gather consents from holders of its 9.750% Senior Secured Amortizing Notes due 2031. The purpose is to implement proposed amendments to the indenture dated February 18, 2026, which governs the Notes issuance. This move by the company is being made under the consent solicitation statement released the same day. Gran Tierra, trading under symbols NYSE American: GTE, TSX: GTE, and LSE: GTE, aims to secure necessary approvals for the changes and has set specific terms and conditions for the process. Capitalized terms in the announcement carry the definitions provided in the consent solicitation statement.

data.title: Binance introduces Agentic Wallet features for AI control, enhancing crypto security. Learn more about this development.
data.description: Binance has introduced Agentic Wallet controls that allow AI agents to securely handle cryptocurrency. This innovative system is designed to enhance security measures and streamline crypto management processes. The Agentic Wallet effectively safeguards digital assets while enabling AI agents to carry out transactions efficiently. This development is important as it signifies a significant step towards enhancing the security of cryptocurrency transactions. The introduction of these controls marks a new era in crypto management and emphasizes the importance of integrating AI technology for secure financial operations.
